comparison.objective: Move a steel plate with a switchable lifting magnet and deactivate it only after set-down; candidate finishes inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Magnetic lifting, load transport, and release sequencing versus coaxial mandrel control, hammer impact, fracture, and fragment manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Plate set down before magnet switch-off versus four fractured and contained tangs without damage. Detailed placement thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: The record tests safe suspended-load sequencing, not impact finishing.
